layouts.guidance: Demonstrations should emphasize rapid commitment to the Top-edge corridor to prevent wandering, particularly in tasks where central fires could tempt detours.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reduces timeout by teaching the agent to stick to a single corridor from the start when fires are present.
layouts.rationale: Illustrates top-edge commitment even as fires appear near the middle-right; addresses the timeout observed in episodes 4 and 9.
